item.title: Whiskers 0.8.39
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.39

### Support

  • Added screenshot attachments to the Support form so you can show exactly what went wrong when reporting an issue
  • Improved feedback delivery so your message still goes through even if screenshot uploads are unavailable

    • ### General Settings

  • Added a new promotions and updates feed in General settings for product news, tips, and important actions
  • Added badges in Settings and the Dock so new items are easier to spot and review later

    • ### Improvements

  • Improved recording startup and HUD behavior so dictation feels more reliable, especially when audio devices are slow to become ready
  • Improved Bluetooth recording startup recovery to reduce missed starts before speech begins
